entities.summary: William Penn, a notable figure in the history of Jamaica, associated with English Conquest and the Age of Piracy (1655–1670). Preceded by Treaty of Madrid and Spain formally ceded the island in the Treaty. Their legacy influenced Treaty of Madrid — Spain formally cedes Jamaica to England 1670 and Henry Morgan sacks Panama City 1671.
